notes.title: Version 2.0 - Gameplay Overhaul
notes.notes:
• Reworked character upgrade system
    ◦ Every upgrade now counts individually.
    ◦ Every character now has a unique upgrade pool.
    ◦ Get 1 Reroll when level up by default.
• Reworked weapon system: you may only pick weapons at the pregame screen
• Added the Extreme difficulty and a new enemy type.
• Now difficulties and weapons need to be unlocked by playing.
